task_text:
The developer dashboard keeps timing out while loading our internal tool server. In tool_server.py, the default listing payload returned by list_tools() currently embeds every tool's full JSON input schema, which has become far too large for clients that are only doing discovery. Refactor the server so that:
1. list_tools() returns only each tool's name and description (no input schema data of any kind in the listing payload), and
2. a new function get_tool_schema(name) returns the full, exact JSON input schema for the single tool being asked about.
Do not change what any existing tool does when invoked, and do not change call_tool(name, args)'s interface or behavior.
